pages.title: Connected Cards
pages.text: Definitions > Triggers opens a visual script: WHEN selects the combat event, IF lists conditions, and THEN lists ordered actions. Add a condition or action from its type picker, then fill its settings. Click an existing card to edit it. Scorch modifies Fireball; Gathering Thunder modifies Lightning Bolt.

pages.title: Choose an Event
pages.text: hit runs when you damage a target. kill runs when you kill one. hurt responds when you are hit. death responds when you are killed. The server evaluates scripts; client timing cannot grant a proc.

pages.title: Chance and Cooldown
pages.text: Chance uses 0 to 1: 0.25 is 25%. mastery:proc_chance adds to it, clamped to a valid probability. Cooldown is ticks after a successful proc. Set 20 for one second. An action can also have its own chance.

pages.title: Attach the Script
pages.text: A trigger requires a purchased node effect: mastery:trigger, with trigger set to the script ID. For spell-only behavior, set the node Type to modifier, select Spell, and put that active skill in Dependencies. The modifier uses a slot and only reacts to its assigned spell. Use passive for a general combat trigger.

pages.title: Order Matters
pages.text: Actions execute top to bottom. ^ moves an action earlier; minus removes it. For example, apply a keyword before checking it in a later action. Conditions on an individual action allow interactions without gating the entire script.

pages.title: Recursion Boundaries
pages.text: Script actions and proc projectiles do not recursively start hit/hurt chains. Their actual kills and deaths can run distinct kill/death triggers once. Proc casts and keyword actions are bounded. Build an explicit action sequence instead of relying on a hit proc to trigger itself.

pages.title: Keyword Tooltips
pages.text: In a keyword script, Settings > Description adds optional tooltip text. Names such as Scorch can be hovered in screen text, guide pages, and tooltips. Stack limits, lifetime, periodic actions, and threshold effects come directly from the script. Use distinct names so each keyword is unambiguous.

pages.title: Tempo Charge Modifier
pages.text: On a modifier node, select the target spell and add a mastery:spell_modifier effect. Set Extra charges to a whole number, such as 2. Rank 3 then grants six additional charges while assigned and enabled. Each modifier uses a slot. Passive nodes may use the same effect with a spell filter. Tempo Not Time is optional; without it this bonus has no effect.
